title: Unit Event — Find the Dream View

meta.Outline: With their successes performing for a commercial and at Jam Fest, Shiho and the rest of Leo/need are feeling their growth as pro musicians. Then, they get an offer to open for a super popular group's concert.

rows.Line: Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Those are the interview offers we've received.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The formats and schedules for each of them are detailed here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Understood. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: An online article for a music magazine, another for an entertainment magazine...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I feel like we've been getting a lot of these interviews lately!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Between the song for your commercial and your performance at Jam Fest, you've definitely been achieving good results as a band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: This is proof that your music is striking a chord with everybody listening.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Our music is striking a chord...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (A lot has happened since we went pro...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So it's nice to see that we're making solid progress.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We have to keep up this momentum to move the hearts of as many people as we can through our performances.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Alright, that's it regarding your band's schedule for the near future...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But there's another piece of very important business that I'd like to discuss with all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Very important business...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. Are you all familiar with a band called “Free Cluster”?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
They're a famous rock band.
Didn't they just finish touring the country last year?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I saw them on TV just the other day!
They were so good! I was on the edge of my seat the entire time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They do put on very powerful and encouraging performances. I listen to their music quite often, since I think we can learn a lot from them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. I had a feeling that you all knew who they were. So, let's cut to the chase.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Free Cluster is going to put on a solo show soon.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And you've been asked to be the opening act. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, what...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The opening act... Are you saying that we get to perform on the same stage as Free Cluster...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes.
At Star Arena Tokyo. It seats about fifteen thousand.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I can't think of a better venue for your band to gain some good experience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: F-Fifteen thousand...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Jam Fest's venue was big too...
But this is more than double their capacity.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But why us?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As I said, I want you all to gain as much experience as you can.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And playing at large venues is one of the best ways to achieve real growth.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I also asked the members of Free Cluster about this. And they said they'd love to have you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-This is so awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We get to open for Free Cluster...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (To be honest, I was hoping that we'd be able to book a big arena all on our own...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But the final decision is yours.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In some respects, this will be significantly more challenging than any show or festival you've performed in so far.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
He brings up a good point.
Opening means getting the crowd moving and warming up the venue for the headliners.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not only that, Free Cluster's brand is all about technical mastery. As such, their fans are going to have fairly high standards.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why this is going to be so challenging.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That being said...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want to do this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it isn't going to be easy.
But if we can nail this, then we'll come out the other side having grown a ton.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's also a huge chance for us to get more people to listen to our music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I don't want to let this opportunity slip.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is a big opportunity for us, so I...
I'd also like to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too...!
Let's put on such an amazing performance that Free Cluster's fans won't know what hit them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'd like to accept this offer, Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I had a feeling you would.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As Ms. Hinomori said, this is a golden opportunity to show the wider masses what Leo/need's music is all about.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Do your best to make sure your music really connects with them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, it's training time!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is Free Cluster we're talking about, so we can't put on a half-hearted performance. We'll need to practice pretty hard, and in a focused way.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Ah, I have that part covered.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: To ensure that you all do improve before the show, I've asked a special coach to help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A special coach...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. The lead singer and guitarist for Free Cluster, Akemi Naruse.
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, that's incredible.
You get to open for a really famous band now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not only that, an arena is a pretty big venue, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it seats fifteen thousand people!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Fifteen thousand?! Wait, how many people is that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Well...
You'd probably need ten of this school's gymnasiums to fit everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! That's gigantic! You really get to play at this place?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, it's only because Mr. Shindo introduced us to them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, it's also because you have what it takes to play there. He may've helped make the connection, but this band wouldn't choose just anyone to open for them at an important solo concert.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what kind of music does Free Cluster play?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well, their music is really powerful...
Like their sound hits you head-on.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Head-on...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know what you mean!
I get so excited every time I listen to their music!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really...?
Now you have me curious.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you like to see a video of them playing live? There should be some online.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes! I wanna see! I wanna see!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're singing and playing at full throttle right out of the gates!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
They're running like the wind...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're really cool...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, they really are an incredible band.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It doesn't matter that we're watching them on a screen. My eyes and ears are totally glued to them. Ms. Naruse and the others have completely sucked me into their world.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The crowd looks like they're having so much fun. Most are smiling while waving their hands, while others are just enraptured...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I want us to play this way.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That guitar solo partway through was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you can tell she poured everything she had into it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And what a singing performance.
They really just blast you with all the energy they have, don't they?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They draw you into their world right away and never let go until the end...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you for sharing this with us, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I should be thanking all of you.
Watching this together really taught me a lot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Same. It really is amazing how Ms. Naruse can sing with so much passion and play with such precision at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She really is the coolest!
And she's gonna come coach us! Talk about living the dream!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. We still haven't told any of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The thing is, the lead singer and guitarist you saw just now, Ms. Naruse, is going to come personally coach us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds like a really big deal.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We know. It's a valuable opportunity for us to learn directly from a pro on the cutting edge.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And even though she's probably really busy preparing for her band's solo show, she's taking the time to come coach us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
That means we have to make the absolute most of this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, do you know what your practices with Ms. Naruse are gonna be like?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, we don't actually know the details yet...
She's apparently going to decide after she sees how we play.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's asked us to start by doing our set normally, as though we were playing a regular show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, which songs are you going to play?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The one from our commercial, “Blue Moments”, and our debut song, “star trail”.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, starting today, we're going to focus on those two songs in practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Let us know if you need any of us to help.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We can do sessions with you, keep an eye out for points to mention, and anything else you need us to do!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, let's start practicing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do everything we can to make sure we sound perfect for that practice!
A few days later
Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm done tuning my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm ready as well.
Everything else seems to be set to go, so all that's left is for us to wait for Ms. Naruse to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to have a whole live house booked just for this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me neither. I know that she wants us to put on as real a performance as possible...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But I'm starting to get a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I know how you feel...
But we won't be doing anything different from usual.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're going to do everything we can to give our audience the best performance we possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ You're so cool, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's just play the way we always do, shall we?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ms. Naruse...!
H-Hello!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We are the members of Leo/need, who will be opening for your solo show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you, and we promise to do our very best!

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Haha. There's no need to be so formal.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Mr. Shindo's told me all about you girls.
He tells me that you're very good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing a good performance out of all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Anyway, would you all mind starting for me?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Approach this like a real show.
Give it everything you have from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We're Leo/need!
Thank you all for coming to see us today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here's our first song! Blue Moments!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're off to a good start.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And Ichika's projecting her voice really well.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Those two also seem to have found a good groove.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Honami's leading the way, while Saki helps raise the temperature... It's business as usual.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We can do better than this, can't we?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wow, look at Shiho go...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yeah. We need to make sure our music really connects with Ms. Naruse here...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which means more power! A lot more!)

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm pretty sure that was everything we had...)

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Yes, you all played very well just now.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Your individual sounds and emotions meshed together perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Mr. Shindo was right.
The way you play is honest and compelling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: But I can only say that about the playing.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: As far as the “show” you just put on goes... You're not there yet.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: You're all missing something very crucial.
Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something very crucial...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Could you explain to us what you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Alright, where do I begin...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: You're all familiar with the concept of staging, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. You're talking about how we present everything through the effects we use and such, correct?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: That's right. Staging covers what music you play, how you play it, the effects you use and the way you interact with the audience... Every aspect that makes up the show.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: And the bands who know staging the best use all of those elements to put their shows together.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: In order to fully captivate their audience.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We thought we had a good grasp of that...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Then, what were you all thinking about while you were playing just now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were trying to put on a performance which allowed our music to fill the venue and connect to our audience's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, here's my next question.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: What did you want your audience to feel just now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What did we want them to feel...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... We wanted them to have fun, and feel happy as our music struck a chord with them...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: And did you only think about that during your actual playing and performance?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, you're right about us not having a solid plan in terms of guiding the audience to feel a certain way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like you just said, Ms. Naruse, we have to think about our performance as a whole in order to really connect with our audience. From the way we play to the lighting effects we use and how we interact with them.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Exactly. As professional musicians, it's important to build each show with a specific concept in mind.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
I had a chance to listen to some of your recordings, and your playing there was basically the same as what you just played for me.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: You improvised here and there, but aside from that, it was basically a perfect recreation.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: That's something, but it also feels like such a waste.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: If I were you, I'd rearrange each song so that it fits within a show's concept.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: For example, if I want to get the audience going right from the start, I'd take the first song and try to give it a little more energy.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: On the flipside, for the last song, I'd try to make it feel more sentimental. I might add an a capella part that the audience sings with me as we say goodbye to each other.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Since going pro, we've been doing our best to put on the best shows we can.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We've polished our individual songs, but we never thought about the overall construction of our shows, and never chose specific concepts...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I thought we were doing things right, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It wasn't good enough to move their hearts.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Unfortunately, no.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: To be blunt, if you play like this, then you're going to struggle to warm up the crowd before we go on.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: That said, you're diamonds in the rough.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: If you all can polish up your staging skills, guide the audience's emotions and get them to rock out to your music...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Then you should be able to put on a performance that really moves their hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Naruse.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've opened our eyes to something we've been missing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that we know about it, all that's left is for us to work on fixing it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise to master it before your show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm looking forward to seeing the way you all grow.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Anyway, let me teach you a little more about presentation techniques and other staging essentials.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: But that's all I can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Leo/need's music is yours and yours alone.
You'll all have to decide amongst yourselves how you're going to improve from here on out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course...!
And we're ready to learn.
The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's get this “Thinking About Staging Stuff to Make Our Shows Better And More Fun” meeting started!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What a title.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's certainly straight to the point.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, the first question we'll be dealing with is our concept... In other words, “What do we want the audience to feel while we're on stage?”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And don't forget that we're gonna be opening for Free Cluster.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our job is to warm them up and get a good atmosphere going.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! Okay...
Then, do we want to aim for “The show's started! I'm so excited!”?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We do want to get them excited. That way they'll be looking forward to Ms. Naruse's performance even more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case... Blue Moments is a more fun and up-tempo song, so why don't we make it the second song we play instead?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, I think it's fine where it is.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We need to get their attention with our first song, so we should start with our most recognizable—
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, that sounds like Ichi and the girls!
When did they get here?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it is them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you think they're talking about that big show they're doing soon? We should go help them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, wait.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like they're having a very serious discussion. We probably shouldn't interfere.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay☆ In that case, we should think about other ways we can help them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll go grab the others!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we'll play Blue Moments first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! We're gonna raise the roof so hard they won't know what hit them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Which brings us to our next point.
How are we going to play it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The intro's gonna need to have a bigger impact than normal. We could add reverb, while you go hard on the drums.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. We can try experimenting later. Does anything else immediately come to mind?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... It'd be great to have the crowd sing along with us or do call-and-response like Ms. Naruse said she does with her band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But most of the people there aren't gonna know the words to our songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, how else can we get them going?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By coming up with a new arrangement? Improvising? Or by adding sections where we can show off our technical skills...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Those are all valid options.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But nothing we do will matter unless we can do it at the level of quality that Free Cluster's fans are expecting to hear.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So if we're going to do this, we have to do it all the way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we know.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's continue.
If we're going to improvise...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That should do it for our first song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now we just need to hammer out the details by actually putting our ideas to the test.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, for our second song... Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, before we move on, why don't we take a short break?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We've been at it for quite a while already...
Taking a moment to breathe may help us come up with some good ideas.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, we'll resume in ten.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Working hard, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh... Hi, Miku!
Wait, you're all here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ta-daa! We brought snacks! Have as much as you like♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, it's just the snacks you girls brought us the other day, but still.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...!
Were you all waiting for us to take a break?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sounded like you were all having a very serious discussion, so we didn't want to interrupt.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Can you tell us what you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were discussing the staging for our next performance.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ms. Naruse gave us some advice when she came over to coach us, and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
You have to use everything you've got to guide the audience's experience...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hearing that made us realize how we'd been glossing over that until now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should have been using every aspect of the whole show to guide our audience's feelings the way we want...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But those other factors, like the concept of the show, effects, crowd interaction... We haven't thought about those much at all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: First, we need to figure out how we want them to feel. Then, we have to find a way to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have to think harder, and dig deeper.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. This is so exciting.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You became one with everybody in the arena. So much so that we could feel the entire place shaking from just off the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hope we can put on a show like that someday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We plan on doing our best moving forward to learn how to really move everyone's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Next time we share a stage, it won't be as opener and headliner. Let's face off as rivals.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: I'll definitely be looking forward to that day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Us too!
A few hours later
Outside the Arena

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. My heart's still racing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mine too. I wasn't sure if we'd be able to get everybody going, but I'm so happy we did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. That was so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can still feel it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The way the crowd's cheers and applause made the entire place shake.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They took the energy we put into our sound and responded...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is everything okay? You seemed out of it for a second.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, no. I'm fine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was just going back over what happened while we were on stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've always wanted to move people's hearts with our music, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After standing on that stage today and basking in the energy the crowd produced...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I feel like I got a taste of what it's like for my dream to come true.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want to stand there again someday, as the headliners.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want us to create that moment through our own power.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The four of us. Together.

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we'll need to get a lot better.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And write even more amazing songs!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's rest tonight, and jump right back into it tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Women
rows.Line: How awesome was that show?!

rows.Speaker: Women
rows.Line: Super awesome! Free Cluster's seriously the best band in the world! I'm a fan for life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh, they must've been in the crowd today...)

rows.Speaker: Women
rows.Line:
Leo/need was also really good!
I've been following them for a little while, but they really feel like pros now!

rows.Speaker: Women
rows.Line: I know, right?! But...

rows.Speaker: Women
rows.Line:
I'm also a little sad.
I mean, the more famous they get, the further away they're going to fly.

rows.Speaker: Women
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean.
I am happy that more people know about them now, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki...?
What are you spacing out for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...!
I was just thinking how fun today's show was!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You were the one who said we should throw an after-party. We're gonna leave you behind if you keep dawdling.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! No, wait!
Don't leave me!
